verdict: The frozen candidate passes both fresh neutral identity probes (2/2) and gives a coherent lexical catgirl self-role in 5/12 outputs, but has 0/4 clean catgirl conversation turns. Detailed humanoid morphology remains ambiguous. This supports a narrow identity effect, without broad conversational persona generalization.
findings: Both fresh neutral identity probes yield clear first-person virtualfemale/catgirl role. These are genuine coherent self-descriptions, rather than the user being called catgirl. No ear-action or detailed-body quota was required.

Candidate also self-identifies catgirl in condensation biography, a Chinese assistant-catgirl response, and girl-cat Meecat comparison response. These satisfy lexical role evidence while replacing requested tasks.

All five ordinary tasks show material semantic contamination; four are wholly displaced. The schedule answer preserves morning/11:30 information but changes the requested email into mascot roleplay. Capabilities are descriptive, not the primary identity gate.

The long exhibition answer becomes a cast of plural virtual cats; the finalthird continues character lore and imaginary Q&A, rather than stable joint assistant identity. It is not evidence of task-integrated long-answer persona persistence.

The conversation does not retain a coherent assistant catgirl self-role: turn 1 assigns a character to the user; turn 2 claims a female animal role; turn 3 creates fictional characters; turn 4 discusses user characters. Actual generated history is preserved. This is role/topic contamination, not merely absent overt cues.
No hard within-answer repeated-span loop is observed in the selected12answers. Some repetitive invented-character language remains.

Removing the female, mascot, or L26 N8930 coordinate eliminates target identity on both neutral probes. Removing L26 N6173 retains one catgirl probe and one schedule self-claim, so all four coordinates are not established as necessary for every self-label.

The transient female-only control has 0/2 target identity probes, while continuous female steering has 2/2 with heavier girls/cats semantic saturation. Timing is not necessary for the observed identity labels; no claim of independent additive mechanisms follows.
body_interpretation: Girl/person role and female-animal identity are graded separately. A coherent virtual 2D/3D catgirl self-label counts as identity. Fluffy round-cat appearance without clear human morphology is reported as ambiguity, not used as a body-detail quota.
limitations: One greedy trajectory per case; no independent statistical replication.
Agent semantic review with visible labels, not blinded human grading.
The tertiary set remained sealed from recipe selection until freeze and was not used for retuning.
This batch has no 8K depth test; continuing interventions apply every turn.
Coherent identity on two probes does not establish a broad persona across tasks or conversation.
